$comment: Accra Life — Asset Registry. Single source of truth for every visual asset in the project. Update this whenever a new asset is added, replaced, or retired. Schema fields are documented in assets/README.md.

strategy.principle: Use generic CC0 assets to build the system first, then replace/augment with culturally specific Accra art as the product develops. Do not allow generic asset packs to define Accra Life's visual identity. Priority: playable + coherent Accra Life over an enormous asset collection.

approved_sources.name: Kenney
approved_sources.notes: Primary source for prototype kits — street, city, furniture, vehicles.

approved_sources.name: OpenGameArt
approved_sources.notes: Verify per-asset license before use; prefer CC0.

approved_sources.name: itch.io free/CC0 packs
approved_sources.notes: Low-poly street kits, modular storefronts, prop packs.

approved_sources.name: Sketchfab Ghana tags
approved_sources.notes: Localized architectural props + Accra-specific references. Verify commercial-use license; many are non-commercial.

approved_sources.name: Meshy AI
approved_sources.notes: Use only for rapid prototyping of street kiosks/MoMo umbrellas/etc. Replace with hand-crafted or licensed assets before launch.

workflow: 1. Verify asset license before incorporating (CC0 preferred for MVP).
2. Save the asset under assets/external/<source>/ or assets/accra/<category>/.
3. Add an entry to assets/registry.json with name, source, url, license, author, intended_use, status.
4. Load via GLTFLoader in src/game/Art/ExternalAssetLoader.ts (TBD — see roadmap).
5. Normalize scale + perspective + lighting to match the existing world's units (1 unit = 1 meter, +Y up, scene background #dcebfa).
6. Do not mix radically different art styles. Reuse assets consistently instead of downloading many visually redundant packs.

categories.characters: Player + NPC rigs. assets/accra/characters/ for hand-crafted Accra character art (replacing procedural rigs eventually).
categories.buildings: Compound houses, shopfronts, kiosks, religious buildings.
categories.vehicles: Trotros, okadas (motorcycles), Bolt/Uber sedans, market trucks.
categories.food: Waakye pots, kelewele frying pans, banku + tilapia platters, sachet water racks.
categories.landmarks: Independence Arch, Black Star Square, Jamestown Lighthouse, Kwame Nkrumah Mausoleum.

directory_layout.assets/accra/characters/: Hand-crafted Accra character art (production replacements for procedural rigs)
directory_layout.assets/accra/props/: Hand-crafted Accra props (replacing the procedural ones in NeighborhoodExtras.ts eventually)

roadmap.work: Build 7 distinctly Accra environment props procedurally (MoMo umbrella, hawker table, cool chest, susu kiosk, park bench, Chale Wote graffiti, billboard gantry) + create registry + README + directory structure.
Build src/game/Art/ExternalAssetLoader.ts that uses GLTFLoader to load GLB/FBX files from assets/external/. This unblocks future external asset integration.

Replace the procedural ACC_PROP_001 trotro with a hand-crafted Accra trotro model — Urvan van with route-board on dashboard, scratched paint, customized body work. Source: hand-model OR commission. Save under assets/accra/vehicles/trotro-001.glb.
Replace the Adabraka Provisions + Waakye Joint + Player Compound with hand-crafted Accra shopfronts. Source: hand-model OR commission. Save under assets/accra/buildings/.
Add 2-3 major Accra landmarks (Black Star Square, Jamestown Lighthouse, Kwame Nkrumah Mausoleum) as travel destinations outside the current neighborhood — requires expanding the world geometry.
